{{Youmay|the Ithorian ritual|[[Harvest ceremony|the Ewok ritual]]}}
The '''Harvest Ceremony''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] ritual practiced on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] by their kind. During the ceremony, Ithorians would gather a specimen from a plant sampling for use in growing hybrid species.
